एकत्रिषड्वसुचतुःकलसान् स्थापयेत् प्रिये ॥ 83 ॥
3.m: Having thus drawn the yantra according to the injunctions, the best knower of mantras, / O beloved, should install one, three, six, eight, or four jars,

3.s:
madhyādicaturasrāntaṃ dvātriṃśat kalasān priye |
athavāṣṭādaśeśāni sapta  vā  daśa vā priye || 84 ||
3.d:
मध्यादिचतुरस्रान्तं द्वात्रिंशत् कलसान् प्रिये ।
अथवाष्टादशेशानि सप्त  वा  दश वा प्रिये ॥ 84 ॥
3.m: From the center up to the square enclosure, thirty-two jars, O beloved; / or eighteen, O Ruler, or seven, or ten, O beloved,

3.s:
caturo vāpyathaikaṃ vā kuryāt sādhakasattamaḥ |
asthiraktaśirātantumṛṇmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ jalam || 85 ||
3.d:
चतुरो वाप्यथैकं वा कुर्यात् साधकसत्तमः ।
अस्थिरक्तशिरातन्तुमृण्मांसं रुधिरं जलम् ॥ 85 ॥
3.m: Or four, or even one, the best of practitioners should place; / bone, blood, veins, fiber, clay, flesh, blood, water,

3.s:
carmavastraśilākūrmanārikelaphalaṃ   śiraḥ |
mantraprāṇasamāyuktāṃ yajet  kalasadevatām || 86 ||
3.d:
चर्मवस्त्रशिलाकूर्मनारिकेलफलं   शिरः ।
मन्त्रप्राणसमायुक्तां यजेत्  कलसदेवताम् ॥ 86 ॥
3.m: Skin, cloth, stone, tortoise, coconut fruit, head— / one should worship the deity of the jar endowed with the life of the mantra,

3.s:
sāvitrīnāparāṅgāni mātaroj bhairavānvitāḥ |
vidikṣu   guruvighneśadurgākṣetrapatīn  priye || 87 ||
3.d:
सावित्रीनापराङ्गानि मातरोज् भैरवान्विताः ।
विदिक्षु   गुरुविघ्नेशदुर्गाक्षेत्रपतीन्  प्रिये ॥ 87 ॥
3.m: The limbs of Sāvitrī and Parā, the Mothers accompanied by Bhairavas, / and in the intermediate directions, O beloved, the guru, Vighneśa, Durgā, and the lords of the field.

3.s:
kalaseṣu  samabhyarcya  vidhivanmantravittamaḥ |
abhiṣiñcet priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarvapāpapraśāntaye || 88 ||
3.d:
कलसेषु  समभ्यर्च्य  विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः ।
अभिषिञ्चेत् प्रियं शिष्यं सर्वपापप्रशान्तये ॥ 88 ॥
3.m: Having worshipped properly in the jars, the best knower of mantras / should consecrate the beloved disciple for the complete pacification of all sins.

3.s:
āyuḥ śrīkāntisaubhāgyavidyārogyādikaṃ bhavet |
rājābhiṣikto   labhate  catuḥsāgaragāṃ   mahīm || 89 ||
3.d:
आयुः श्रीकान्तिसौभाग्यविद्यारोग्यादिकं भवेत् ।
राजाभिषिक्तो   लभते  चतुःसागरगां   महीम् ॥ 89 ॥
3.m: Long life, prosperity, radiance, good fortune, learning, health, and the like shall come to be; / consecrated, a king attains the earth extending to the four oceans;

3.s:
akiñcano'bhiṣiktaśca  mahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāt |
vandhyābhiṣiktā labhate putraṃ sarvaguṇānvitam || 90 ||
3.d:
अकिञ्चनोऽभिषिक्तश्च  महदैश्वर्यमाप्नुयात् ।
वन्ध्याभिषिक्ता लभते पुत्रं सर्वगुणान्वितम् ॥ 90 ॥
3.m: And a destitute person, when consecrated, obtains great sovereignty; / a barren woman, when consecrated, obtains a son endowed with all virtues;

3.s:
bhūtāpamṛtyurogādyā  vinaśyanti   na   saṃśayaḥ |
trilauhe vāpi bhūrje vā  likhitvā yantramuttamam || 91 ||
3.d:
भूतापमृत्युरोगाद्या  विनश्यन्ति   न   संशयः ।
त्रिलौहे वापि भूर्जे वा  लिखित्वा यन्त्रमुत्तमम् ॥ 91 ॥
3.m: Spirits, untimely death, diseases, and the like are destroyed without doubt. / Having written this supreme yantra on three metals or on birch bark,

3.s:
vidhṛtaṃ  bāhunā   devi   sarvarakṣākaraṃ   bhavet |
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ  vidyālābhaṃ  yaśo  jayam || 92 ||
3.d:
विधृतं  बाहुना   देवि   सर्वरक्षाकरं   भवेत् ।
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं  विद्यालाभं  यशो  जयम् ॥ 92 ॥
3.m: When worn on the arm, O Goddess, it grants all protection, / lifespan, health, sovereignty, acquisition of learning, fame, and victory.

3.s:
yad yat  svamanaso'bhīṣṭaṃ  tattadāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ |
khaḍgavaśyaṃ vayaḥstambhaṃ yakṣiṇyañjanapādukām || 93 ||
3.d:
यद् यत्  स्वमनसोऽभीष्टं  तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयः ।
खड्गवश्यं वयःस्तम्भं यक्षिण्यञ्जनपादुकाम् ॥ 93 ॥
3.m: Whatever is desired by his own mind, that he obtains without doubt: / mastery of the sword, arresting of age, yakṣiṇī, magical eye-salve, sandals,

3.s:
aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhyādi      mahārasarasāyanam |
sañjīvayogaguṭikāpramukhākhilasiddhayaḥ      || 94 ||
3.d:
अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्ध्यादि      महारसरसायनम् ।
सञ्जीवयोगगुटिकाप्रमुखाखिलसिद्धयः      ॥ 94 ॥
3.m: The eight supernatural powers beginning with atomicity, the great elixir of mercury, / and all supernatural powers headed by the life-restoring pill.

3.s:
parāprāsādamantrajñairdṛśyante     nātra    saṃśayaḥ |
ṣaṭ  karmāṇi  prayuñjīta nānyathā bhavati priye || 95 ||
3.d:
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञैर्दृश्यन्ते     नात्र    संशयः ।
षट्  कर्माणि  प्रयुञ्जीत नान्यथा भवति प्रिये ॥ 95 ॥
3.m: These are seen by those who know the Parāprāsāda mantra, there is no doubt; / one should apply the six rites; it does not happen otherwise, O beloved.

3.s:
pītadravyairharidrādyaiḥ     samitpatraphalādibhiḥ |
juhuyāt   pūrvavanmantrī   devatādhyānatatparaḥ || 96 ||
3.d:
पीतद्रव्यैर्हरिद्राद्यैः     समित्पत्रफलादिभिः ।
जुहुयात्   पूर्ववन्मन्त्री   देवताध्यानतत्परः ॥ 96 ॥
3.m: With yellow substances such as turmeric, with firewood, leaves, fruits, and the like, / the practitioner, intent upon meditation on the deity, should offer oblations as before.

3.s:
vākśrotragatidṛksenānadīgraharipūn     priye |
nānāduṣṭamṛgān  devi  stambhayennātra  saṃśayaḥ || 97 ||
3.d:
वाक्श्रोत्रगतिदृक्सेनानदीग्रहरिपून्     प्रिये ।
नानादुष्टमृगान्  देवि  स्तम्भयेन्नात्र  संशयः ॥ 97 ॥
3.m: Speech, hearing, movement, sight, an army, a river, planets, enemies, O beloved, / and various harmful beasts, O Goddess, he immobilizes; there is no doubt about this.

3.s:
grahavegādiduṣṭānāṃ      vināśanakaraṃ     priye |
asmāt parataraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 98 ||
3.d:
ग्रहवेगादिदुष्टानां      विनाशनकरं     प्रिये ।
अस्मात् परतरं ध्यानं नास्ति सत्यं न संशयः ॥ 98 ॥
3.m: It brings about the destruction of evil beings such as seizing spirits and [dangerous] drives, my dear; / there is no meditation superior to this, truly, there is no doubt.

3.s:
tāmasadhyānajaṃ    devi   phalametadudīritam |
duṣṭamāraṇakarmāṇi  vidhinānena   sādhayet || 99 ||
3.d:
तामसध्यानजं    देवि   फलमेतदुदीरितम् ।
दुष्टमारणकर्माणि  विधिनानेन   साधयेत् ॥ 99 ॥
3.m: This fruit, O Goddess, has been proclaimed as arising from tamasic meditation. / Through this rite one should accomplish magical acts of slaying the wicked.

3.s:
ityādi dhyānabhedena jñātvā gurumukhāt priye |
ṣaṭ karmāṇi prayuñjīta nānyathā vīravandite || 100 ||
3.d:
इत्यादि ध्यानभेदेन ज्ञात्वा गुरुमुखात् प्रिये ।
षट् कर्माणि प्रयुञ्जीत नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते ॥ 100 ॥
3.m: Having learned thus from the mouth of the guru according to the divisions of meditation, my dear, / one should apply the six magical acts, not otherwise, O you who are praised by heroes.

3.s:
khadiraśvetamandārasitabhānusamidvaraiḥ      |
palāśodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāpāmārgasatvacaiḥ || 101 ||
3.d:
खदिरश्वेतमन्दारसितभानुसमिद्वरैः      ।
पलाशोदुम्बराश्वत्थप्लक्षापामार्गसत्वचैः ॥ 101 ॥
3.m: With choice firewood of khadira, white mandāra, and white arka; / with the sound barks of palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, plakṣa, and apāmārga;

3.s:
nandyāvarttasitāmbhojahayārikusumādibhiḥ  |
sitairanyaiḥ śubhairdrravyaiḥ samitpatraphalāntaraḥ || 102 ||
3.d:
नन्द्यावर्त्तसिताम्भोजहयारिकुसुमादिभिः  ।
सितैरन्यैः शुभैर्द्र्रव्यैः समित्पत्रफलान्तरः ॥ 102 ॥
3.m: with flowers such as nandyāvarta, white lotus, and oleander; / and with other white, auspicious substances, amidst firewood, leaves, and fruits;

3.s:
bhakṣyaiśca   pāyasairdūrvāsahitaistilataṇḍulaiḥ |
madhuratrayasaṃyuktairmantravit    kulanāyike || 103 ||
3.d:
भक्ष्यैश्च   पायसैर्दूर्वासहितैस्तिलतण्डुलैः ।
मधुरत्रयसंयुक्तैर्मन्त्रवित्    कुलनायिके ॥ 103 ॥
3.m: and with foods, milk-porridge, along with dūrvā grass, sesamum and rice-grains, / joined with the three sweet substances, the knower of mantra, O heroine of Kula,

3.s:
ekena  vātha   sarvairvā   tatkāryagurulāghavam |
jñātvā  devi  sahasrantu  juhuyādatha  pañca  vā || 104 ||
3.d:
एकेन  वाथ   सर्वैर्वा   तत्कार्यगुरुलाघवम् ।
ज्ञात्वा  देवि  सहस्रन्तु  जुहुयादथ  पञ्च  वा ॥ 104 ॥
3.m: with one or with all [of these], having perceived / the gravity or lightness of that undertaking, O Goddess, should offer one thousand oblations, or five [hundred],

3.s:
ayutaṃ  niyutaṃ  vāpi  prayutaṃ  vā  kuleśvari |
tattatkarmodite   kuṇḍe  saṃskṛte   havyavāhane || 105 ||
3.d:
अयुतं  नियुतं  वापि  प्रयुतं  वा  कुलेश्वरि ।
तत्तत्कर्मोदिते   कुण्डे  संस्कृते   हव्यवाहने ॥ 105 ॥
3.m: or ten thousand, one hundred thousand, or even one million, O Mistress of Kula, / in the sacrificial pit prescribed for that respective rite, in consecrated fire.

3.s:
āvāhya devatāmasmin dhyātvā sāvaraṇāṃ priye |
vidhivajjuhuyāddevi       tadgatenāntarātmanā || 106 ||
3.d:
आवाह्य देवतामस्मिन् ध्यात्वा सावरणां प्रिये ।
विधिवज्जुहुयाद्देवि       तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ॥ 106 ॥
3.m: Having invoked the deity in it and meditated on her together with her retinue, my dear, / he should offer oblations according to rule, O Goddess, with his inner self focused upon her.

3.s:
sarvarogavraṇonmādāpasmārotpātayakṣmajam     |
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ    tatkṣaṇānnātra   saṃśayaḥ || 107 ||
3.d:
सर्वरोगव्रणोन्मादापस्मारोत्पातयक्ष्मजम्     ।
सर्वदुःखप्रशमनं    तत्क्षणान्नात्र   संशयः ॥ 107 ॥
3.m: It pacifies all suffering arising from all diseases, wounds, insanity, / epilepsy, portents, and consumption immediately, without doubt.

3.s:
anena sarvaśāntiñca jñānaṃ  vidyāṃ labhet priye |
kadambāśokavakulapunnāgāmramadhūkajaiḥ    || 108 ||
3.d:
अनेन सर्वशान्तिञ्च ज्ञानं  विद्यां लभेत् प्रिये ।
कदम्बाशोकवकुलपुन्नागाम्रमधूकजैः    ॥ 108 ॥
3.m: Through this one obtains all pacification, knowledge, and wisdom, my dear. / With [flowers] born of kadamba, aśoka, bakula, punnāga, mango, and madhūka;

3.s:
campakadvayapālāśapāṭalaśrīkapitthakaiḥ   |
mālatīmallikājātibandhūkāruṇapaṅkajaiḥ || 109 ||
3.d:
चम्पकद्वयपालाशपाटलश्रीकपित्थकैः   ।
मालतीमल्लिकाजातिबन्धूकारुणपङ्कजैः ॥ 109 ॥
3.m: with both kinds of campaka, palāśa, pāṭalā, bilva, and kapittha; / with mālatī, mallikā, jātī, bandhūka, and red lotuses;

3.s:
kalhārāruṇamandārayūthikundajavādibhiḥ   |
sanārikelakadalīdrākṣekṣupṛthukairapi      || 110 ||
3.d:
कल्हारारुणमन्दारयूथिकुन्दजवादिभिः   ।
सनारिकेलकदलीद्राक्षेक्षुपृथुकैरपि      ॥ 110 ॥
3.m: with kalhāra, red mandāra, yūthikā, kunda, and javā, and so forth; / and with coconuts, plantains, grapes, sugarcane, and flattened rice;

3.s:
candanāgurukarpūrarocanākuṃkumādibhiḥ     |
raktairanyaiḥ  śubhadravyaiḥ samidhṛtaphalodbhavaiḥ || 111 ||
3.d:
चन्दनागुरुकर्पूररोचनाकुंकुमादिभिः     ।
रक्तैरन्यैः  शुभद्रव्यैः समिधृतफलोद्भवैः ॥ 111 ॥
3.m: with sandalwood, agallochum, camphor, rocanā, saffron, and so forth; / and with other red, auspicious substances produced from firewood, ghee, and fruits;

3.s:
pūrvavajjuhuyāddevi vidhivanmantravittamaḥ    |
mahīpatīṃśca puruṣān kāntā yauvanagavītāḥ || 112 ||
3.d:
पूर्ववज्जुहुयाद्देवि विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः    ।
महीपतींश्च पुरुषान् कान्ता यौवनगवीताः ॥ 112 ॥
3.m: the foremost knower of mantras should offer oblations as before according to rule, O Goddess: / rulers of the earth, men, and lovely women proud of their youth,

3.s:
siṃhān mattān tathā vyāghrān mṛgān duṣṭān gajānapi |
siddhadevāpsaroyakṣagandharvavanitāstathā    |
devānapi kuleśāni vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥ || 113 ||
3.d:
सिंहान् मत्तान् तथा व्याघ्रान् मृगान् दुष्टान् गजानपि ।
सिद्धदेवाप्सरोयक्षगन्धर्ववनितास्तथा    ।
देवानपि कुलेशानि वशयेन्नात्र संशयः ॥ 113 ॥
3.m: lions, rutting tigers, wild beasts, and even rogue elephants, / as well as the women of siddhas, gods, apsarases, yakṣas, and gandharvas, / and even gods, O Sovereign of Kula, he subjugates—there is no doubt about this.

3.s:
vājīlavaṇahomena striyamākarṣayed dhruvam |
vidhinānena deveśi saubhāgyamuttamaṃ labhet || 114 ||
3.d:
वाजीलवणहोमेन स्त्रियमाकर्षयेद् ध्रुवम् ।
विधिनानेन देवेशि सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लभेत् ॥ 114 ॥
3.m: Through the offering of horse-salt into the fire, he definitely attracts a woman. / Through this rite, O Goddess of the gods, one obtains supreme good fortune.

3.s:
bahunātra kimuktena triṣu lokeṣu mantriṇām |
anena mantrarājena nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacit || 115 ||
3.d:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन त्रिषु लोकेषु मन्त्रिणाम् ।
अनेन मन्त्रराजेन नासाध्यं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥ 115 ॥
3.m: What is the use of saying much here? For practitioners in the three worlds, / there is nothing anywhere that cannot be accomplished by this king of mantras.

3.s:
ūrdhvāmnāyaikaniṣṇātaḥ parāprāsādamantravit |
kulārṇavārthatattvajño jīvanmuktaḥ kuleśvari || 116 ||
3.d:
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायैकनिष्णातः पराप्रासादमन्त्रवित् ।
कुलार्णवार्थतत्त्वज्ञो जीवन्मुक्तः कुलेश्वरि ॥ 116 ॥
3.m: One who is skilled solely in the upper transmission, knowing the parāprāsāda mantra, / and knowing the truth of the meaning of the Kulārṇava, is liberated while living, O Mistress of Kula.

3.s:
sutīrthe vāpyatīrthe vā jalamadhye'pi vā vasan |
parāprāsādamantrajño   mukta  eva   na  saṃśayaḥ || 117 ||
3.d:
सुतीर्थे वाप्यतीर्थे वा जलमध्येऽपि वा वसन् ।
पराप्रासादमन्त्रज्ञो   मुक्त  एव   न  संशयः ॥ 117 ॥
3.m: Whether residing at an auspicious pilgrimage site, at a non-pilgrimage site, or even amidst water, / the knower of the parāprāsāda mantra is liberated indeed; there is no doubt.

3.s:
dikpīṭhakṣetramudrādivṛkṣavallīmaṭhādikāḥ  |
jñeyā bhairavadevyaśca ūrdhvāmnāyasya pārvati || 118 ||
3.d:
दिक्पीठक्षेत्रमुद्रादिवृक्षवल्लीमठादिकाः  ।
ज्ञेया भैरवदेव्यश्च ऊर्ध्वाम्नायस्य पार्वति ॥ 118 ॥
3.m: The directions, seats, sacred fields, seals, and so on, the trees, creepers, hermitages, and so forth, / and the Bhairavas and goddesses of the upper transmission must be known, O Pārvatī.

3.s:
nimbakāraskaronmattakaṇṭakīvipradantibhiḥ     |
asthikaṇṭakavṛkṣādyairdravyairaśubhasādhanaiḥ       || 119 ||
3.d:
निम्बकारस्करोन्मत्तकण्टकीविप्रदन्तिभिः     ।
अस्थिकण्टकवृक्षाद्यैर्द्रव्यैरशुभसाधनैः       ॥ 119 ॥
3.m: With nimba, kāraskara, dhattūra, thorny trees, and danti; / with bones, thorny trees, and so on, substances which are means of inauspicious rites;

3.s:
vaṭukaiḥ    kṛṣṇavarṇaiśca   samitpatraphalāntaraiḥ |
gṛhadhūmacitāṅgāratrikaṭvamlacitāñjanaiḥ        || 120 ||
3.d:
वटुकैः    कृष्णवर्णैश्च   समित्पत्रफलान्तरैः ।
गृहधूमचिताङ्गारत्रिकट्वम्लचिताञ्जनैः        ॥ 120 ॥
3.m: with black vaṭuka beans, along with firewood, leaves, and fruits; / with soot from the house, charcoal from the funeral pyre, the three pungents, sour gruel, and funeral-pyre collyrium;

3.s:
unmattarasasaṃsiktai  piṣṭvā  samyak  prasecitaiḥ |
sādhyapādarajobhiśca      citābhasmasamanvitaiḥ || 121 ||
3.d:
उन्मत्तरससंसिक्तै  पिष्ट्वा  सम्यक्  प्रसेचितैः ।
साध्यपादरजोभिश्च      चिताभस्मसमन्वितैः ॥ 121 ॥
3.m: ground and thoroughly moistened with juice of dhattūra, / and mixed with the dust of the target's feet and ashes from the funeral pyre,

3.s:
sādhyapratikṛtiṃ       kuryādekanakṣatravṛkṣajām |
samyakpratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ kuṇḍasyopari lambayet || 122 ||
3.d:
साध्यप्रतिकृतिं       कुर्यादेकनक्षत्रवृक्षजाम् ।
सम्यक्प्रतिष्ठितप्राणां कुण्डस्योपरि लम्बयेत् ॥ 122 ॥
3.m: he should make an effigy of the target born from the tree of [the target's] birth-star; / having properly installed the vital breaths in it, he should hang it over the sacrificial pit.

3.s:
khanettatpratimāṃ  mantrī  kuṇḍasyādho  yathāvidhi |
malīmasena       manasā     cogradṛṣṭiramarṣaṇaḥ || 123 ||
3.d:
खनेत्तत्प्रतिमां  मन्त्री  कुण्डस्याधो  यथाविधि ।
मलीमसेन       मनसा     चोग्रदृष्टिरमर्षणः ॥ 123 ॥
3.m: The practitioner should dig up that effigy from beneath the sacrificial pit according to rule / with an impure mind, a fierce gaze, and full of wrath.

3.s:
citānale  viṣataru  saptakāṣṭhasamedhite |
taddravyairjuhuyāddevi  vidhivanmantravittamaḥ || 124 ||
3.d:
चितानले  विषतरु  सप्तकाष्ठसमेधिते ।
तद्द्रव्यैर्जुहुयाद्देवि  विधिवन्मन्त्रवित्तमः ॥ 124 ॥
3.m: In the fire of a funeral pyre, kindled with wood from seven poison trees, / with those substances the foremost knower of mantras should offer oblations according to rule, O Goddess.

3.s:
kuryādvidveṣaṇoccāṭamāraṇāni na saṃśayaḥ |
śāntike sāttvikaṃ devi śvetavarṇaṃ vicintayet || 125 ||
3.d:
कुर्याद्विद्वेषणोच्चाटमारणानि न संशयः ।
शान्तिके सात्त्विकं देवि श्वेतवर्णं विचिन्तयेत् ॥ 125 ॥
3.m: He will accomplish sowing dissension, expulsion, and slaying; there is no doubt. / In an act of pacification, O Goddess, one should imagine a sattvic, white form.

3.s:
vaśye  tu  rājasaṃ  devi  raktavarṇaṃ  vicintayet |
tāmasaṃ   krūrakāryeṣu  kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ   vicintayet || 126 ||
3.d:
वश्ये  तु  राजसं  देवि  रक्तवर्णं  विचिन्तयेत् ।
तामसं   क्रूरकार्येषु  कृष्णवर्णं   विचिन्तयेत् ॥ 126 ॥
3.m: In subjugation, however, O Goddess, one should imagine a rajasic, red form; / in cruel deeds, one should imagine a tamasic, black form.

3.s:
ātmarakṣāṃ purā kṛtvā paścāt karmāṇi sādhayet |
yo'nyathā  kurute  mohāt   sa  bhaveddevatāpaśuḥ || 127 ||
3.d:
आत्मरक्षां पुरा कृत्वा पश्चात् कर्माणि साधयेत् ।
योऽन्यथा  कुरुते  मोहात्   स  भवेद्देवतापशुः ॥ 127 ॥
3.m: Having first performed self-protection, one should later accomplish the rites. / He who acts otherwise out of delusion becomes a beast of the deity.

3.s:
tasmāddevi  mahāṣoḍhānyāsaṃ pūjāṃ baliṃ sudhīḥ |
kṛtvā karmāṇi kurvīta nānyathā vīravandite || 128 ||
3.d:
तस्माद्देवि  महाषोढान्यासं पूजां बलिं सुधीः ।
कृत्वा कर्माणि कुर्वीत नान्यथा वीरवन्दिते ॥ 128 ॥
3.m: Therefore, O Goddess, having performed the great sixteenfold nyāsa, worship, and the animal offering, / the wise one should perform the rites, not otherwise, O you who are praised by heroes.

3.s:
mūlādhārasarojāntarvahnimadhyagataṃ       priye |
parāprāsādabījaṃ tat kalpāntāgnisamaprabham || 129 ||
3.d:
मूलाधारसरोजान्तर्वह्निमध्यगतं       प्रिये ।
पराप्रासादबीजं तत् कल्पान्ताग्निसमप्रभम् ॥ 129 ॥
3.m: Situated in the middle of the fire within the lotus of the mūlādhāra, my dear, / is that seed-syllable of parāprāsāda, equal in radiance to the fire of universal destruction,

3.s:
pratilomasu   saṃvītaṃ   daśabhirvyāpakākṣaraiḥ |
svayaṃ   kālānalasamaḥ  sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraḥ || 130 ||
3.d:
प्रतिलोमसु   संवीतं   दशभिर्व्यापकाक्षरैः ।
स्वयं   कालानलसमः  सर्वभूतभयङ्करः ॥ 130 ॥
3.m: encompassed in reverse order by the ten all-pervading letters, / he himself being like the fire of destruction, terrifying to all beings.

3.s:
dakṣiṇāśāmukho  bhūtvātyugradṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ |
yauvanollāsasahitaḥ  parāprāsādasaṃjñakam || 131 ||
3.d:
दक्षिणाशामुखो  भूत्वात्युग्रदृष्टिमलीमसः ।
यौवनोल्लाससहितः  पराप्रासादसंज्ञकम् ॥ 131 ॥
3.m: Facing the southern quarter, with an extremely fierce gaze, soiled, / accompanied by the exuberance of youth, [the mantra] named parāprāsāda—

3.s:
mantraṃ  maṇḍalakaṃ  japyādaṣṭottarasahasrakam |
aniṣṭakāriṇaḥ sattvān kalahāyāsakāriṇaḥ || 132 ||
3.d:
मन्त्रं  मण्डलकं  जप्यादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् ।
अनिष्टकारिणः सत्त्वान् कलहायासकारिणः ॥ 132 ॥
3.m: he should recite this mantra for a cycle of one thousand and eight times. / Harm-inflicting beings, those who cause strife and exhaustion,

3.s:
vṛthā dveṣakarān  krūrān  saparyāvighnakāriṇaḥ |
bhūtopagrahavetālān  piśācān   yakṣarākṣasān || 133 ||
3.d:
वृथा द्वेषकरान्  क्रूरान्  सपर्याविघ्नकारिणः ।
भूतोपग्रहवेतालान्  पिशाचान्   यक्षराक्षसान् ॥ 133 ॥
3.m: those who needlessly cause hatred, the cruel ones who cause obstacles to worship, / bhūtas, secondary spirits, vetālas, piśācas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas,

3.s:
ityādiduṣṭajantūṃśca  sadā  kleśakarān  parān |
tadvahnimadhyapatitānnirdagdhāṃśca         cintayet |
kṣaṇena  nāśamāyānti   śalabhā  iva   pāvake || 134 ||
3.d:
इत्यादिदुष्टजन्तूंश्च  सदा  क्लेशकरान्  परान् ।
तद्वह्निमध्यपतितान्निर्दग्धांश्च         चिन्तयेत् ।
क्षणेन  नाशमायान्ति   शलभा  इव   पावके ॥ 134 ॥
3.m: and other such malignant creatures, who continually inflict affliction upon others— / he should imagine them fallen into the middle of that fire and consumed. / In an instant they perish like moths in a fire.

3.s:
yasyamūdhnī smaredbījaṃ sa mṛtyumadhigacchati |
dhyānenānena deveśi kālādīnapi nāśayet || 135 ||
3.d:
यस्यमूध्नी स्मरेद्बीजं स मृत्युमधिगच्छति ।
ध्यानेनानेन देवेशि कालादीनपि नाशयेत् ॥ 135 ॥
3.m: On whose head he remembers this seed-syllable, that person attains death. / Through this meditation, O Goddess of the gods, he destroys even Time and the rest.

3.s:
iti te kathitaḥ kiñcit kāmyakarmavidhiḥ priye |
samāsena  kuleśāni  ki  bhūyaḥ  śrotumicchasi || 136 ||
3.d:
इति ते कथितः किञ्चित् काम्यकर्मविधिः प्रिये ।
समासेन  कुलेशानि  कि  भूयः  श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 136 ॥
3.m: Thus has the rule of desire-prompted rites been told to you in part, my dear, / in brief, O Sovereign of Kula. What more do you wish to hear?

3.s: atha saptadaśollāsaḥ
3.d: अथ सप्तदशोल्लासः

3.s:
śrī devyuvāca
kuleśa śrotumicchāmi gurunāmādivāsanām |
tattvaṃ  kulapadārthānāṃ  vada  me  parameśvara || 1 ||
3.d:
श्री देव्युवाच
कुलेश श्रोतुमिच्छामि गुरुनामादिवासनाम् ।
तत्त्वं  कुलपदार्थानां  वद  मे  परमेश्वर ॥ 1 ॥
3.m: The auspicious Goddess said: / O Lord of Kula, I wish to hear the inner meaning of the names of the guru and others. / Tell me, O Supreme Lord, the reality of the categories of Kula.

3.s:
īśvara uvāca
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
tasya   śravaṇamātreṇa  kulajñānaṃ  prakāśate || 2 ||
3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।
तस्य   श्रवणमात्रेण  कुलज्ञानं  प्रकाशते ॥ 2 ॥
3.m:
The Lord said:
Listen, Goddess, I shall proclaim what you ask of me; / merely by hearing it, Kula knowledge shines forth.

3.s:
namaste  nātha  bhagavan  śivāya  gururūpiṇe |
vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai     svīkṛtānekavigraha || 3 ||
3.d:
नमस्ते  नाथ  भगवन्  शिवाय  गुरुरूपिणे ।
विद्यावतारसंसिद्ध्यै     स्वीकृतानेकविग्रह ॥ 3 ॥
3.m: Obeisance to you, Lord, blessed one, to Śiva in the form of the guru, / who have assumed multiple physical forms to bring about the descent of sacred knowledge.

3.s:
nārāyaṇasvarūpāya       paramātmasvarūpiṇe |
sarvājñānatamobhedabhānave     caitanyāya    ca || 4 ||
3.d:
नारायणस्वरूपाय       परमात्मस्वरूपिणे ।
सर्वाज्ञानतमोभेदभानवे     चैतन्याय    च ॥ 4 ॥
3.m: To him whose intrinsic nature is Nārāyaṇa, whose intrinsic nature is the Supreme Self, / the sun that pierces the darkness of all ignorance, and pure consciousness;

3.s:
sarvajñāya dayākḷptavigrahāya     śivātmane |
paratreha  ca  bhaktānāṃ  bhavyānāṃ  bhāvadāyine || 5 ||
3.d:
सर्वज्ञाय दयाकॢप्तविग्रहाय     शिवात्मने ।
परत्रेह  च  भक्तानां  भव्यानां  भावदायिने ॥ 5 ॥
3.m: to the omniscient one, whose physical form is fashioned from compassion, whose self is Śiva, / who bestows spiritual realization upon his devoted, auspicious devotees both in the hereafter and here;

3.s:
purastāt pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe namaḥ kuryāmuparyadhaḥ |
sadā  saccittarūpeṇa  vidhehi  tava dāsatām || 6 ||
3.d:
पुरस्तात् पार्श्वयोः पृष्ठे नमः कुर्यामुपर्यधः ।
सदा  सच्चित्तरूपेण  विधेहि  तव दासताम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.m: I offer obeisance in front, on both sides, behind, above, and below; / through your form of eternal, pure consciousness, always ordain my servitude to you.

3.s:
guśabdastvandhakāraḥ syāt ruśabdastannirodhakaḥ |
andhakāranirodhatvāt       gururityabhidhīyate || 7 ||
3.d:
गुशब्दस्त्वन्धकारः स्यात् रुशब्दस्तन्निरोधकः ।
अन्धकारनिरोधत्वात्       गुरुरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 7 ॥
3.m: The syllable 'gu' is darkness, and the syllable 'ru' is that which obstructs it; / because he obstructs darkness, he is designated as 'guru'.

3.s:
gakāraḥ siddhadaḥ prokto rephaḥ pāpasya dāhakaḥ |
ukāro  viṣṇurityuktastritayātmā  guruḥ  paraḥ || 8 ||
3.d:
गकारः सिद्धदः प्रोक्तो रेफः पापस्य दाहकः ।
उकारो  विष्णुरित्युक्तस्त्रितयात्मा  गुरुः  परः ॥ 8 ॥
3.m: The letter 'g' is said to bestow spiritual perfection, the letter 'r' consumes demerit, / and the letter 'u' is said to be Viṣṇu: the supreme guru is identical with this triad.

3.s:
gakāro jñānasampattī rephastatra prakāśakaḥ |
ukāraḥ śivatādātmyaṃ  gururityabhidhīyate || 9 ||
3.d:
गकारो ज्ञानसम्पत्ती रेफस्तत्र प्रकाशकः ।
उकारः शिवतादात्म्यं  गुरुरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 9 ॥
3.m: The letter 'g' is the attainment of knowledge, the letter 'r' is the illuminator thereof, / and the letter 'u' is identity with Śiva; [thus] he is designated as 'guru'.

3.s:
guhyāgamātmatattvāndhanaddhānāṃ    bodhanādapi |
rudrādidevarūpatvād      gururityabhidhīyate || 10 ||
3.d:
गुह्यागमात्मतत्त्वान्धनद्धानां    बोधनादपि ।
रुद्रादिदेवरूपत्वाद्      गुरुरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 10 ॥
3.m: Moreover, because he awakens those bound in blindness to the reality of the secret Āgamas and the Self, / and because his form is that of the deities beginning with Rudra, he is designated as 'guru'.

3.s:
svayamācarate   śiṣyānācāre  sthāpayatyapi |
ācinotīha śāstrārthānācāryastena kathyate || 11 ||
3.d:
स्वयमाचरते   शिष्यानाचारे  स्थापयत्यपि ।
आचिनोतीह शास्त्रार्थानाचार्यस्तेन कथ्यते ॥ 11 ॥
3.m: He practices it himself, he establishes his disciples in proper conduct, / and he gathers here the meanings of the scriptures; therefore he is called 'ācārya'.

3.s:
carācarasamāsannamadhyāpayati   yaḥ  svayam |
yamādiyogasiddhatvādācārya   iti  kathyate || 12 ||
3.d:
चराचरसमासन्नमध्यापयति   यः  स्वयम् ।
यमादियोगसिद्धत्वादाचार्य   इति  कथ्यते ॥ 12 ॥
3.m: He who himself teaches what pertains to the moving and unmoving [world], / and who is perfected in yoga beginning with restraint, is called 'ācārya'.

3.s:
ātmabhāvapradānāttu     rāgadveṣādivarjjanāt |
dhyānaikaniṣṭhācittatvādārādhya iti kathyate || 13 ||
3.d:
आत्मभावप्रदानात्तु     रागद्वेषादिवर्ज्जनात् ।
ध्यानैकनिष्ठाचित्तत्वादाराध्य इति कथ्यते ॥ 13 ॥
3.m: Because he imparts the state of the Self, is free from passion and hatred, / and has a mind single-mindedly intent upon meditation, he is called 'ārādhya'.

3.s:
devatārūpadhāritvācchiṣyānugrahakāraṇāt   |
karuṇāmayamūttītvāddeśikaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 14 ||
3.d:
देवतारूपधारित्वाच्छिष्यानुग्रहकारणात्   ।
करुणामयमूत्तीत्वाद्देशिकः कथितः प्रिये ॥ 14 ॥
3.m: Because he bears the form of the deity, for the sake of bestowing grace upon his disciples, / and because his physical form is made of compassion, he is called 'deśika', my beloved.

3.s:
svāntaḥśāntisamunmīlatparatattvārthacintanāt    |
mithyājñānavihīnatvāt svāmīti kathitaḥ priye || 15 ||
3.d:
स्वान्तःशान्तिसमुन्मीलत्परतत्त्वार्थचिन्तनात्    ।
मिथ्याज्ञानविहीनत्वात् स्वामीति कथितः प्रिये ॥ 15 ॥
3.m: Because he contemplates the meaning of the supreme reality blossoming in the peace of his inner heart, / and because he is free of false knowledge, he is called 'svāmin', my beloved.

3.s:
manodoṣādidūratvāddhetuvādādivarjjanāt         |
śvādiprāṇiṣu sādṛśyād ramyatvācca maheśvaraḥ || 16 ||
3.d:
मनोदोषादिदूरत्वाद्धेतुवादादिवर्ज्जनात्         ।
श्वादिप्राणिषु सादृश्याद् रम्यत्वाच्च महेश्वरः ॥ 16 ॥
3.m: Because he is far removed from the faults of the mind, rejects dialectical disputation, / sees sameness in living beings such as dogs, and is delightful, [he is] 'maheśvara'.

3.s:
śrīmokṣajñānadātṛtvānnādabrahmātmabodhanāt       |
sthagitājñānacihnatvāt śrīnāthaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 17 ||
3.d:
श्रीमोक्षज्ञानदातृत्वान्नादब्रह्मात्मबोधनात्       ।
स्थगिताज्ञानचिह्नत्वात् श्रीनाथः कथितः प्रिये ॥ 17 ॥
3.m: Because he gives the auspicious knowledge of liberation, awakens the Self to the phonic absolute, / and has obscured the marks of ignorance, he is called 'śrīnātha', my beloved.

3.s:
deśakālāvirodhena varttamānāt kulāgame |
vaśīkṛtajagajjīvāddeva   ityabhidhīyate || 18 ||
3.d:
देशकालाविरोधेन वर्त्तमानात् कुलागमे ।
वशीकृतजगज्जीवाद्देव   इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 18 ॥
3.m: Because he conducts himself in accordance with the Kula transmission without conflict with place and time, / and has brought under control the living souls of the universe, he is designated as 'deva'.

3.s:
bhavapāśapraśamanāt     ṭaṅkārendukaśekharāt |
rakṣaṇāt kamanīyatvāt bhaṭṭāraka itīritaḥ || 19 ||
3.d:
भवपाशप्रशमनात्     टङ्कारेन्दुकशेखरात् ।
रक्षणात् कमनीयत्वात् भट्टारक इतीरितः ॥ 19 ॥
3.m: Because he pacifies the bonds of worldly existence, has the crest-crescent moon of a mason's chisel, / protects, and is desirable, he is called 'bhaṭṭāraka'.

3.s:
praguptāgamavedāntarahasyārthavibhāvanāt   |
bhuktimuktipradānācca prabhurityabhidhīyate || 20 ||
3.d:
प्रगुप्तागमवेदान्तरहस्यार्थविभावनात्   ।
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानाच्च प्रभुरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 20 ॥
3.m: Because he fully realizes the secret meaning of the hidden Āgamas and Vedānta, / and because he bestows enjoyment and liberation, he is designated as 'prabhu'.

3.s:
yonimudrānusandhānāt    prasphuranmantravaibhavāt |
gīrvāṇagaṇapūjyatvād yogīti kathitaḥ priye || 21 ||
3.d:
योनिमुद्रानुसन्धानात्    प्रस्फुरन्मन्त्रवैभवात् ।
गीर्वाणगणपूज्यत्वाद् योगीति कथितः प्रिये ॥ 21 ॥
3.m: Because of his contemplation of the yonimudrā, the glory of his radiant mantras, / and his worthiness to be worshipped by the host of gods, he is called 'yogin', my beloved.

3.s:
saṅgaduḥkhaparityāgāt yatra kutrāśramāśrayāt |
mitha ātmanibandhatvāt saṃyamītyabhidhīyate || 22 ||
3.d:
सङ्गदुःखपरित्यागात् यत्र कुत्राश्रमाश्रयात् ।
मिथ आत्मनिबन्धत्वात् संयमीत्यभिधीयते ॥ 22 ॥
3.m: Because he has cast aside the suffering of attachment, takes shelter in any hermitage whatsoever, / and is internally bound to the Self, he is designated as 'saṃyamin'.

3.s:
tattvasvarūpamananāt      parivādādivajītāt |
svīkārāt śubhakāryāṇāṃ tapasvītyabhidhīyate || 23 ||
3.d:
तत्त्वस्वरूपमननात्      परिवादादिवजीतात् ।
स्वीकारात् शुभकार्याणां तपस्वीत्यभिधीयते ॥ 23 ॥
3.m: Because he contemplates the intrinsic nature of reality, is free from slander and the like, / and undertakes auspicious actions, he is designated as 'tapasvin'.

3.s:
akṣaratvādvareṇyatvāddhūtasaṃsārabandhanāt    |
tattvamasyarthasiddhatvāt avadhūto'bhidhīyate || 24 ||
3.d:
अक्षरत्वाद्वरेण्यत्वाद्धूतसंसारबन्धनात्    ।
तत्त्वमस्यर्थसिद्धत्वात् अवधूतोऽभिधीयते ॥ 24 ॥
3.m: Because he is imperishable, supreme, has shaken off the bonds of the transmigratory cycle, / and has accomplished the meaning of 'Thou art that', he is designated as 'avadhūta'.

3.s:
vītarāgamadakleśakopamātsaryamohataḥ |
rajastamovidūratvādvīra  ityabhidhīyate || 25 ||
3.d:
वीतरागमदक्लेशकोपमात्सर्यमोहतः ।
रजस्तमोविदूरत्वाद्वीर  इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 25 ॥
3.m: Because he is free from passion, pride, affliction, anger, envy, and delusion, / and because he is far removed from passion and darkness, he is designated as 'vīra'.

3.s:
kulaṃ gotraṃ samākhyātaṃ tacca śaktiśivodbhavam |
yena mokṣa iti jñānaṃ kaulikaḥ so'bhidhīyate || 26 ||
3.d:
कुलं गोत्रं समाख्यातं तच्च शक्तिशिवोद्भवम् ।
येन मोक्ष इति ज्ञानं कौलिकः सोऽभिधीयते ॥ 26 ॥
3.m: Kula is declared to be lineage, and that arises from Śakti and Śiva; / he through whom knowledge is liberation is designated as a 'Kaulika'.

3.s:
akulaṃ śiva ityuktaṃ kulaṃ śaktiḥ prakīttītā |
kulākulānusandhānānnipuṇāḥ kaulikāḥ priye || 27 ||
3.d:
अकुलं शिव इत्युक्तं कुलं शक्तिः प्रकीत्तीता ।
कुलाकुलानुसन्धानान्निपुणाः कौलिकाः प्रिये ॥ 27 ॥
3.m: Akula is said to be Śiva, and Kula is proclaimed to be Śakti; / those skilled in the continuous contemplation of Kula and Akula are Kaulikas, my beloved.

3.s:
sārasaṃgrahaṇāccaiva        dharmamārgapravarttanāt |
karaṇagrāmaniyamāt sādhakaḥ so'bhidhīyate || 28 ||
3.d:
सारसंग्रहणाच्चैव        धर्ममार्गप्रवर्त्तनात् ।
करणग्रामनियमात् साधकः सोऽभिधीयते ॥ 28 ॥
3.m: Because he gathers the essential core, sets in motion the path of righteousness, / and restrains the collection of sensory organs, he is designated as a 'sādhaka'.

3.s:
bhajanāt parayā bhaktyā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
taratyakhiladuḥkhāni    tasmādbhakta   itīritaḥ || 29 ||
3.d:
भजनात् परया भक्त्या मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः ।
तरत्यखिलदुःखानि    तस्माद्भक्त   इतीरितः ॥ 29 ॥
3.m: Because he worships with supreme devotion through actions of mind, speech, and body, / he crosses over all sorrows; therefore he is called a 'bhakta'.

3.s:
śarīramarthaṃ prāṇāṃśca sadgurubhyo nivedya yaḥ |
gurubhyaḥ śikṣate yogaṃ śiṣya ityabhidhīyate || 30 ||
3.d:
शरीरमर्थं प्राणांश्च सद्गुरुभ्यो निवेद्य यः ।
गुरुभ्यः शिक्षते योगं शिष्य इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 30 ॥
3.m: He who surrenders body, wealth, and life-breaths to true gurus / and learns yoga from gurus is designated as a 'śiṣya'.

3.s:
yonimudrānusandhānāt   girijāpādasevanāt |
nirlīnopādhivibhavād yoginītyabhidhīyate || 31 ||
3.d:
योनिमुद्रानुसन्धानात्   गिरिजापादसेवनात् ।
निर्लीनोपाधिविभवाद् योगिनीत्यभिधीयते ॥ 31 ॥
3.m: Because of her contemplation of the yonimudrā, service to the feet of the Mountain-born Goddess, / and because the power of limiting adjuncts has dissolved, she is designated as a 'yoginī'.

3.s:
śatakoṭimahādivyayoginīprītikāraṇāt |
tīvramuktipradānācca śaktirityabhidhīyate || 32 ||
3.d:
शतकोटिमहादिव्ययोगिनीप्रीतिकारणात् ।
तीव्रमुक्तिप्रदानाच्च शक्तिरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 32 ॥
3.m: Because she brings pleasure to hundreds of millions of great divine yoginīs, / and because she grants intense liberation, she is designated as 'śakti'.

3.s:
pālanādduritacchedāt kāmitārthasya varddhanāt |
pāduketi samākhyātā mama tattvaṃ  tava  priye || 33 ||
3.d:
पालनाद्दुरितच्छेदात् कामितार्थस्य वर्द्धनात् ।
पादुकेति समाख्याता मम तत्त्वं  तव  प्रिये ॥ 33 ॥
3.m: Because it protects, cuts through misfortune, and increases desired wealth, / it is proclaimed as 'pādukā'—my ontological reality and yours, my beloved.

3.s:
janmāntarasahasreṣu kṛtapāpapraṇāśanāt |
paradevaprakāśācca japa ityabhidhīyate || 34 ||
3.d:
जन्मान्तरसहस्रेषु कृतपापप्रणाशनात् ।
परदेवप्रकाशाच्च जप इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 34 ॥
3.m: Because it destroys demerit accumulated in thousands of other births, / and reveals the supreme deity, it is designated as 'japa'.

3.s:
stokastokena manasaḥ paramaprītikāraṇāt |
stotṛsantāraṇāddevi   stotramityabhidhīyate || 35 ||
3.d:
स्तोकस्तोकेन मनसः परमप्रीतिकारणात् ।
स्तोतृसन्तारणाद्देवि   स्तोत्रमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 35 ॥
3.m: Because little by little it causes supreme delight of the mind, / and because it delivers the praise-singer, O Goddess, it is designated as 'stotra'.

3.s:
yāvadindriyasantāpaṃ  manasā  saṃniyamya ca |
svāntenābhīṣṭadevasya cintanaṃ dhyānamucyate || 36 ||
3.d:
यावदिन्द्रियसन्तापं  मनसा  संनियम्य च ।
स्वान्तेनाभीष्टदेवस्य चिन्तनं ध्यानमुच्यते ॥ 36 ॥
3.m: Completely restraining the agitation of the senses by means of the mind, / contemplation of one's chosen deity with the inner heart is called 'dhyāna'.

3.s:
caritārthavikāśācca rakṣaṇādapi pārvati |
naranārīsvarūpācca caraṇaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 37 ||
3.d:
चरितार्थविकाशाच्च रक्षणादपि पार्वति ।
नरनारीस्वरूपाच्च चरणं कथितं प्रिये ॥ 37 ॥
3.m: Because of the manifestation of the attained goal, and because of protection, O Pārvatī, / and because of having the intrinsic nature of both man and woman, it is called 'caraṇa', my beloved.

3.s:
veditā'khilaśāstrārthasaddharmārthanirūpaṇāt |
darśanānāṃ    pramāṇatvādveda  ityabhidhīyate || 38 ||
3.d:
वेदिताऽखिलशास्त्रार्थसद्धर्मार्थनिरूपणात् ।
दर्शनानां    प्रमाणत्वाद्वेद  इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 38 ॥
3.m: Because it makes known the meaning of all scriptures, ascertains the true goals of duty, / and is the authoritative means of knowledge for philosophical systems, it is designated as 'veda'.

3.s:
puṇyapāpādikathanādrākṣasādinivāraṇāt   |
navabhaktyādijananāt purāṇa iti kathyate || 39 ||
3.d:
पुण्यपापादिकथनाद्राक्षसादिनिवारणात्   ।
नवभक्त्यादिजननात् पुराण इति कथ्यते ॥ 39 ॥
3.m: Because it expounds merit, demerit, and the like, wards off demons and other evils, / and engenders the nine kinds of devotion, it is called 'purāṇa'.

3.s:
śāsanādaniśaṃ devi varṇāśramanivāsinām |
tāraṇāt sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāstramityabhidhīyate || 40 ||
3.d:
शासनादनिशं देवि वर्णाश्रमनिवासिनाम् ।
तारणात् सर्वपापेभ्यः शास्त्रमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 40 ॥
3.m: Because it unceasingly governs those who abide in the classes and life-stages, O Goddess, / and delivers them from all demerits, it is designated as 'śāstra'.

3.s:
smaraṇotsukaniṣṭhānāṃ dharmādharmanirūpaṇāt |
timirotpāṭanāddevi smṛtirityabhidhīyate || 41 ||
3.d:
स्मरणोत्सुकनिष्ठानां धर्माधर्मनिरूपणात् ।
तिमिरोत्पाटनाद्देवि स्मृतिरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 41 ॥
3.m: Because it determines duty and non-duty for those devoted to and eager for recollection, / and eradicates darkness, O Goddess, it is designated as 'smṛti'.

3.s:
iṣṭadharmādikathanāttimirājñānabhañjanāt |
haraṇāt sarvaduḥkhānāṃ itihāsa iti smṛtaḥ || 42 ||
3.d:
इष्टधर्मादिकथनात्तिमिराज्ञानभञ्जनात् ।
हरणात् सर्वदुःखानां इतिहास इति स्मृतः ॥ 42 ॥
3.m: Because it expounds desirable duty and the like, dispels the darkness of ignorance, / and removes all sorrows, it is remembered as 'itihāsa'.

3.s:
ācārakathanāddivyagatiprāptinidānataḥ |
mahātmatattvakathanādāgamaḥ kathitaḥ priye || 43 ||
3.d:
आचारकथनाद्दिव्यगतिप्राप्तिनिदानतः ।
महात्मतत्त्वकथनादागमः कथितः प्रिये ॥ 43 ॥
3.m: Because it expounds conduct, is the cause of attaining the divine realm, / and expounds the reality of the Great Self, it is called 'āgama', my beloved.

3.s:
śākinīgaṇapūjyatvāttāraṇādbhavavāridhe |
parādiśaktisānnidhyācchākta ityabhidhīyate || 44 ||
3.d:
शाकिनीगणपूज्यत्वात्तारणाद्भववारिधे ।
परादिशक्तिसान्निध्याच्छाक्त इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 44 ॥
3.m: Because he is worthy of worship by the hosts of Śākinīs, delivers from the ocean of worldly existence, / and is in proximity to the supreme primal Śakti, he is designated as 'Śākta'.

3.s:
kaumārādinirodhatvāt layajanmādibhañjanāt |
aśeṣakulasambandhāt kaula ityabhidhīyate || 45 ||
3.d:
कौमारादिनिरोधत्वात् लयजन्मादिभञ्जनात् ।
अशेषकुलसम्बन्धात् कौल इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 45 ॥
3.m: Because he restrains [states] beginning with youth, breaks through dissolution, birth, and the like, / and is connected to all Kulas, he is designated as 'Kaula'.

3.s:
pāśacchedakarāddevi   rañjanāt   paratejasaḥ |
yatibhiścintyamānatvāt paramparyamitīritam || 46 ||
3.d:
पाशच्छेदकराद्देवि   रञ्जनात्   परतेजसः ।
यतिभिश्चिन्त्यमानत्वात् परम्पर्यमितीरितम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.m: Because it severs bonds, O Goddess, delights the supreme splendor, / and is constantly contemplated by ascetics, it is said to be 'pāramparya'.

3.s:
saṃsārasārabhūtatvāt      prakāśānandadānataḥ |
yaśaḥ saubhāgyakaraṇāt sampradāya itīritaḥ || 47 ||
3.d:
संसारसारभूतत्वात्      प्रकाशानन्ददानतः ।
यशः सौभाग्यकरणात् सम्प्रदाय इतीरितः ॥ 47 ॥
3.m: Because it constitutes the essence of the transmigratory cycle, because it grants the bliss of illumination, / and because it produces fame and good fortune, it is proclaimed tradition.

3.s:
āditvāt sarvamārgāṇāṃ manollāsapravarddhanāt |
yajñādidharmahetutvādāmnāya   iti   kītītaḥ || 48 ||
3.d:
आदित्वात् सर्वमार्गाणां मनोल्लासप्रवर्द्धनात् ।
यज्ञादिधर्महेतुत्वादाम्नाय   इति   कीतीतः ॥ 48 ॥
3.m: Because it is the origin of all paths, because it magnifies the joy of the mind, / and because it is the cause of righteousness through sacrifice and the like, it is declared sacred transmission.

3.s:
śrutānekamahāmantrayantratantrādidaivatāt     |
śrutau yadanavicchinnācchrauta ityabhidhīyate || 49 ||
3.d:
श्रुतानेकमहामन्त्रयन्त्रतन्त्रादिदैवतात्     ।
श्रुतौ यदनविच्छिन्नाच्छ्रौत इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 49 ॥
3.m: Because its deities begin with the many great mantras, yantras, and tantras that are revealed, / and because it is uninterrupted in revelation, it is designated as based on revelation.

3.s:
āmnāyatattvarūpatvāccāturyārthanirūpaṇāt |
rāgadveṣādiśamanādācāra  iti   kīrttyate || 50 ||
3.d:
आम्नायतत्त्वरूपत्वाच्चातुर्यार्थनिरूपणात् ।
रागद्वेषादिशमनादाचार  इति   कीर्त्त्यते ॥ 50 ॥
3.m: Because it consists of the reality of sacred transmission, because it establishes the four aims, / and because it pacifies passion, hatred, and the rest, it is proclaimed conduct.

3.s:
divyabhāvapradānācca kṣālanāt kalmaṣasya ca |
dīkṣeti   kathitā sadbhirbhavabandhavimocanāt || 51 ||
3.d:
दिव्यभावप्रदानाच्च क्षालनात् कल्मषस्य च ।
दीक्षेति   कथिता सद्भिर्भवबन्धविमोचनात् ॥ 51 ॥
3.m: Because it grants the divine state and washes away defilement, / and because it frees [one] from the bond of worldly existence, it is called initiation by the wise.

3.s:
ahambhāvaharādbhītimathanāt   secanādapi |
kampānandādijananādabhiṣeka iti smṛtaḥ || 52 ||
3.d:
अहम्भावहराद्भीतिमथनात्   सेचनादपि ।
कम्पानन्दादिजननादभिषेक इति स्मृतः ॥ 52 ॥
3.m: Because it destroys egoism, churns away fear, and is an asperging, / and because it produces trembling, bliss, and the like, it is traditionally known as consecration.

3.s:
ulbaṇatvāt paratvācca devatāprītidānataḥ |
śaktipātanimittādapyupadeśa  iti  smṛtaḥ || 53 ||
3.d:
उल्बणत्वात् परत्वाच्च देवताप्रीतिदानतः ।
शक्तिपातनिमित्तादप्युपदेश  इति  स्मृतः ॥ 53 ॥
3.m: Because of its pre-eminence and supreme nature, because it grants the favour of the deity, / and because it is the occasion for the descent of power, it is traditionally known as instruction.

3.s:
mananāttattvarūpasya   devasyāmitatejasaḥ |
trāyate sarvabhayatastasmānmantra itīritaḥ || 54 ||
3.d:
मननात्तत्त्वरूपस्य   देवस्यामिततेजसः ।
त्रायते सर्वभयतस्तस्मान्मन्त्र इतीरितः ॥ 54 ॥
3.m: Because of the meditation upon the God of boundless radiance who is the nature of reality, / and because it protects from all fear, it is therefore called mantra.

3.s:
dehamāsthāya bhaktānāṃ varadānācca pārvati |
tāpatrayādiśamanāddevatā     parikīttītā || 55 ||
3.d:
देहमास्थाय भक्तानां वरदानाच्च पार्वति ।
तापत्रयादिशमनाद्देवता     परिकीत्तीता ॥ 55 ॥
3.m: Because, assuming a body, it grants boons to devotees, O Pārvatī, / and because it pacifies the threefold affliction and other [sorrows], it is proclaimed deity.

3.s:
nyāyopājītavittānāmaṅgeṣu viniveśanāt |
sarvarakṣākarāddevi nyāsa ityabhidhīyate || 56 ||
3.d:
न्यायोपाजीतवित्तानामङ्गेषु विनिवेशनात् ।
सर्वरक्षाकराद्देवि न्यास इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 56 ॥
3.m: Because it deposits within the limbs treasures rightfully acquired, / and because it provides all-around protection, O Goddess, it is designated nyāsa.

3.s:
mudaṃ kurvanti  devānāṃ  manāṃsi  drāvayanti   ca |
tasmānmudrā iti khyātā daśītavyāḥ kuleśvari || 57 ||
3.d:
मुदं कुर्वन्ति  देवानां  मनांसि  द्रावयन्ति   च ।
तस्मान्मुद्रा इति ख्याता दशीतव्याः कुलेश्वरि ॥ 57 ॥
3.m: They produce delight for the gods and melt their minds; / therefore they are known as mudrās, and they must be displayed, O Mistress of Kula.

3.s:
anantaphaladānācca kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣāt |
mātṛkātmatayā lābhakaraṇādakṣamālikā || 58 ||
3.d:
अनन्तफलदानाच्च क्षपिताशेषकल्मषात् ।
मातृकात्मतया लाभकरणादक्षमालिका ॥ 58 ॥
3.m: Because it grants endless fruit, because it destroys all defilement, / and because it brings attainment through its identity with the Mātṛkās, [it is called] rosary.

3.s:
maṅgalatvācca ḍākinyā yoginīgaṇasaṃśrayāt |
lalitatvācca deveśi maṇḍalaṃ parikīttītam || 59 ||
3.d:
मङ्गलत्वाच्च डाकिन्या योगिनीगणसंश्रयात् ।
ललितत्वाच्च देवेशि मण्डलं परिकीत्तीतम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.m: Because of its auspiciousness, because it is the resort of ḍākinīs and the host of yoginīs, / and because of its loveliness, O Ruler of the Gods, it is proclaimed maṇḍala.

3.s:
kamalāsanarūpatvāllaghutattvādināśanāt    |
śamitāpārapāpācca kalaśaḥ parikīttītaḥ || 60 ||
3.d:
कमलासनरूपत्वाल्लघुतत्त्वादिनाशनात्    ।
शमितापारपापाच्च कलशः परिकीत्तीतः ॥ 60 ॥
3.m: Because it has the nature of a lotus seat, because it destroys trivial realities and the like, / and because it pacifies boundless demerit, it is proclaimed the ritual pitcher.

3.s:
yamabhūtādisarvebhyo bhayebhyo'pi kuleśvari |
trāyate satatañcaiva tasmād  yantramitīritam || 61 ||
3.d:
यमभूतादिसर्वेभ्यो भयेभ्योऽपि कुलेश्वरि ।
त्रायते सततञ्चैव तस्माद्  यन्त्रमितीरितम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.m: From all terrors beginning with Yama and spirits, O Mistress of Kula, / it protects constantly; therefore it is proclaimed yantra.

3.s:
ātmasiddhipradānācca sarvaroganivāraṇāt |
navasiddhipradānācca āsanaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 62 ||
3.d:
आत्मसिद्धिप्रदानाच्च सर्वरोगनिवारणात् ।
नवसिद्धिप्रदानाच्च आसनं कथितं प्रिये ॥ 62 ॥
3.m: Because it grants realization of the Self, because it wards off all diseases, / and because it grants the nine supernatural powers, it is declared the seat, O Beloved.

3.s:
māyājālādiśamanānmokṣamārganirūpaṇāt |
aṣṭaduḥkhādivirahān  madyamityabhidhīyate || 63 ||
3.d:
मायाजालादिशमनान्मोक्षमार्गनिरूपणात् ।
अष्टदुःखादिविरहान्  मद्यमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 63 ॥
3.m: Because it pacifies the web of cosmic illusion and the like, because it reveals the path to liberation, / and because it removes the eight miseries and the like, it is designated liquor.

3.s:
mahādānārtharūpatvād yāgabhūmyekakāraṇāt |
madbhāvajananāddevi   madyamityabhidhīyate || 64 ||
3.d:
महादानार्थरूपत्वाद् यागभूम्येककारणात् ।
मद्भावजननाद्देवि   मद्यमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 64 ॥
3.m: Because it has the nature of the object of supreme gift, because it is the sole cause of the sacrificial ground, / and because it produces My state of being, O Goddess, it is designated liquor.

3.s:
sumanasaḥ sevitatvād rājyadatvāt sadā priye |
surākārapradānatvāt   sureti   parikīttītā || 65 ||
3.d:
सुमनसः सेवितत्वाद् राज्यदत्वात् सदा प्रिये ।
सुराकारप्रदानत्वात्   सुरेति   परिकीत्तीता ॥ 65 ॥
3.m: Because it is enjoyed by the wise, because it always bestows kingdom, O Beloved, / and because it grants a divine form, it is proclaimed wine.

3.s:
amṛtāṃśusvarūpatvānmṛtyubhītinivāraṇāt |
tattvaprakāśahetutvādamṛtaṃ  kathitaṃ   priye || 66 ||
3.d:
अमृतांशुस्वरूपत्वान्मृत्युभीतिनिवारणात् ।
तत्त्वप्रकाशहेतुत्वादमृतं  कथितं   प्रिये ॥ 66 ॥
3.m: Because it is of the nature of the moon, because it wards off fear of death, / and because it is the cause of the revelation of reality, it is declared nectar, O Beloved.

3.s:
pānāṅgaviśvarūpatvāttricatuṣkakalāśrayāt |
patitatrāṇanāddevi     pātramityabhidhīyate || 67 ||
3.d:
पानाङ्गविश्वरूपत्वात्त्रिचतुष्ककलाश्रयात् ।
पतितत्राणनाद्देवि     पात्रमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 67 ॥
3.m: Because it is the universal form of the vessel for drinking, because it is the resort of the twelve digits, / and because it protects the fallen, O Goddess, it is designated the vessel.

3.s:
āśuśukṣaṇirūpatvāddhātṛdevapriyādapi    |
rakṣaṇādapi cādheyasyādhāraṃ tu vidurbudhāḥ || 68 ||
3.d:
आशुशुक्षणिरूपत्वाद्धातृदेवप्रियादपि    ।
रक्षणादपि चाधेयस्याधारं तु विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 68 ॥
3.m: Because it has the nature of fire, because it is dear to the creator god, / and because it protects the contents, the wise know it as the base.

3.s:
māṅgalyajananāddevi  saṃvivadānandadānataḥ |
sarvadevapriyatvācca māṃsa ityabhidhīyate || 69 ||
3.d:
माङ्गल्यजननाद्देवि  संविवदानन्ददानतः ।
सर्वदेवप्रियत्वाच्च मांस इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 69 ॥
3.m: Because it produces auspiciousness, O Goddess, because it grants the bliss of disputation, / and because it is dear to all the gods, it is designated meat.

3.s:
pūrvajanmānuśamanājjanmamṛtyunivāraṇāt    |
sampūrṇaphaladānācca pūjeti kathitā priye || 70 ||
3.d:
पूर्वजन्मानुशमनाज्जन्ममृत्युनिवारणात्    ।
सम्पूर्णफलदानाच्च पूजेति कथिता प्रिये ॥ 70 ॥
3.m: Because it quenches previous births, because it wards off birth and death, / and because it grants complete fruit, it is declared worship, O Beloved.

3.s:
abhīṣṭaphaladānācca caturvargaphalāśrayāt |
nandanāt sarvadevānāmarcanaṃ   samudāhṛtam || 71 ||
3.d:
अभीष्टफलदानाच्च चतुर्वर्गफलाश्रयात् ।
नन्दनात् सर्वदेवानामर्चनं   समुदाहृतम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.m: Because it grants the desired fruit, because it is the ground for the fruit of the four aims of life, / and because it gladdens all the gods, it is declared adoration.

3.s:
tattvātmakasya devasya parivāravṛtasya ca |
navānandaprajananāttarpaṇaṃ     samudāhṛtam || 72 ||
3.d:
तत्त्वात्मकस्य देवस्य परिवारवृतस्य च ।
नवानन्दप्रजननात्तर्पणं     समुदाहृतम् ॥ 72 ॥
3.m: For the God whose nature is reality and who is surrounded by his retinue, / because it produces fresh bliss, it is declared libation.

3.s:
gambhīrāpāradaurbhāgyakleśanāśanakāraṇāt |
dharmajñānapradānācca  gandha  ityabhidhīyate || 73 ||
3.d:
गम्भीरापारदौर्भाग्यक्लेशनाशनकारणात् ।
धर्मज्ञानप्रदानाच्च  गन्ध  इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 73 ॥
3.m: Because it destroys deep and boundless misfortune and affliction, / and because it grants knowledge of righteousness, it is designated perfume.

3.s:
āghrāṇanaprajananān mokṣamārgapradarśanāt |
dagdhaduḥkhādidamanādāmoda iti kathyate || 74 ||
3.d:
आघ्राणनप्रजननान् मोक्षमार्गप्रदर्शनात् ।
दग्धदुःखादिदमनादामोद इति कथ्यते ॥ 74 ॥
3.m: Because it produces sweet scent, because it displays the path to liberation, / and because it subdues burnt sorrow and the like, it is called fragrance.

3.s:
annadānāt kuleśāni kṣapitāśeṣakalmaṣāt |
tādātmyakaraṇāddevi akṣatāḥ parikīttītāḥ || 75 ||
3.d:
अन्नदानात् कुलेशानि क्षपिताशेषकल्मषात् ।
तादात्म्यकरणाद्देवि अक्षताः परिकीत्तीताः ॥ 75 ॥
3.m: Because they give food, O Mistress of Kula, because they destroy all defilement, / and because they produce identity, O Goddess, they are proclaimed unbroken grains.

3.s:
puṇyasaṃvarddhanāccāpi   pāpaughaparihārataḥ |
puṣkalārthapradānācca puṣpamityabhidhīyate || 76 ||
3.d:
पुण्यसंवर्द्धनाच्चापि   पापौघपरिहारतः ।
पुष्कलार्थप्रदानाच्च पुष्पमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 76 ॥
3.m: Because it increases merit, because it wards off the flood of demerit, / and because it grants abundant wealth, it is designated flower.

3.s:
dhūtāśeṣamahādoṣapūtigandhaprabhāvataḥ   |
paramānandajananāddhūpa ityabhidhīyate || 77 ||
3.d:
धूताशेषमहादोषपूतिगन्धप्रभावतः   ।
परमानन्दजननाद्धूप इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 77 ॥
3.m: Because its power dispels foul odours and all great faults, / and because it produces supreme bliss, it is designated incense.

3.s:
dīrghājñānamahādhvāntāhaṅkāraparivarjanāt  |
paratattvaprakāśācca dīpa ityabhidhīyate || 78 ||
3.d:
दीर्घाज्ञानमहाध्वान्ताहङ्कारपरिवर्जनात्  ।
परतत्त्वप्रकाशाच्च दीप इत्यभिधीयते ॥ 78 ॥
3.m: Because it removes the great darkness and egoism of long-standing ignorance, / and because it reveals the supreme reality, it is designated lamp.

3.s:
mohadhvāntapraśamanāt   kṣayātīvinivāraṇāt |
divyarūpapradānācca      paratattvaprakāśanāt |
khyāto mokṣo dīpa iti mokṣamārgaikasādhanaḥ || 79 ||
3.d:
मोहध्वान्तप्रशमनात्   क्षयातीविनिवारणात् ।
दिव्यरूपप्रदानाच्च      परतत्त्वप्रकाशनात् ।
ख्यातो मोक्षो दीप इति मोक्षमार्गैकसाधनः ॥ 79 ॥
3.m: Because it pacifies the darkness of delusion, because it wards off wasting and illness, / because it grants a divine form, and because it reveals the supreme reality, / liberation is known as the lamp, the sole means to the path of liberation.

3.s:
catuvīdhaṃ kuleśāni dravyañca ṣaḍrasānvitam |
nivedanādbhavettṛptirnaivedyaṃ      samudāhṛtam || 80 ||
3.d:
चतुवीधं कुलेशानि द्रव्यञ्च षड्रसान्वितम् ।
निवेदनाद्भवेत्तृप्तिर्नैवेद्यं      समुदाहृतम् ॥ 80 ॥
3.m: Substance of four kinds, O Mistress of Kula, endowed with the six flavours, / from the offering of which satisfaction arises, is declared food offering.

3.s:
bahuprakāravicarad bhūtaughaprītikāraṇāt |
liptapāpapraśamanād balirityabhidhīyate || 81 ||
3.d:
बहुप्रकारविचरद् भूतौघप्रीतिकारणात् ।
लिप्तपापप्रशमनाद् बलिरित्यभिधीयते ॥ 81 ॥
3.m: Because it pleases the multitude of spirits roaming in many ways, / and because it pacifies clinging demerit, it is designated bali.

3.s:
tattvatrayaviśuddhiḥ syāttvatsevāmātrataḥ priye |
tattvaprakāśahetutvāttattvatrayamitīritam     || 82 ||
3.d:
तत्त्वत्रयविशुद्धिः स्यात्त्वत्सेवामात्रतः प्रिये ।
तत्त्वप्रकाशहेतुत्वात्तत्त्वत्रयमितीरितम्     ॥ 82 ॥
3.m: Purity of the triad of realities arises merely from service to You, O Beloved; / because it is the cause of the revelation of reality, it is proclaimed the triad of realities.

3.s:
caturvargaphalāvāpāt luṇṭhitājñānabandhanāt |
kalyāṇadharmamūlatvāccalukaṃ kathitaṃ priye || 83 ||
3.d:
चतुर्वर्गफलावापात् लुण्ठिताज्ञानबन्धनात् ।
कल्याणधर्ममूलत्वाच्चलुकं कथितं प्रिये ॥ 83 ॥
3.m: Because of obtaining the fruit of the four aims of life, because of stripping away the bonds of ignorance, / and because it is the root of auspicious duty, it is declared the sip of water, O Beloved.

3.s:
prakāśānandajananāt   sāmarasyapradānataḥ |
darśanāt paratattvasya prasāda iti kathyate || 84 ||
3.d:
प्रकाशानन्दजननात्   सामरस्यप्रदानतः ।
दर्शनात् परतत्त्वस्य प्रसाद इति कथ्यते ॥ 84 ॥
3.m: Because it produces the bliss of illumination, because it grants identity of essence, / and because of the vision of supreme reality, it is called grace.

3.s:
pāśasañchedanāddevi narakasya nivāraṇāt |
pābanāt parameśāni pānamityabhidhīyate || 85 ||
3.d:
पाशसञ्छेदनाद्देवि नरकस्य निवारणात् ।
पाबनात् परमेशानि पानमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 85 ॥
3.m: Because it severs bonds, O Goddess, because it wards off hell, / and because it purifies, O Supreme Ruler, it is designated drink.

3.s:
karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā |
samīpasevā vidhivat upāstiriti kathyate || 86 ||
3.d:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा ।
समीपसेवा विधिवत् उपास्तिरिति कथ्यते ॥ 86 ॥
3.m: By action, mind, and speech, in all states, at all times, / service performed close by according to rule is called worship.

3.s:
pañcāṅgopāsaneneṣṭadevatā    prītidānataḥ |
puraścarati bhaktasya tat puraścaraṇaṃ priye || 87 ||
3.d:
पञ्चाङ्गोपासनेनेष्टदेवता    प्रीतिदानतः ।
पुरश्चरति भक्तस्य तत् पुरश्चरणं प्रिये ॥ 87 ॥
3.m: Because it grants pleasure to the chosen deity through the five-limbed worship, / it moves forward before the devotee; that, O Beloved, is preparatory rite.

3.s:
āvāhanādikarmāṇi ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāvadhi |
vidhinācaraṇaṃ proktaṃ upahāramiti smṛtam || 88 ||
3.d:
आवाहनादिकर्माणि षोडश द्वादशावधि ।
विधिनाचरणं प्रोक्तं उपहारमिति स्मृतम् ॥ 88 ॥
3.m: The rites beginning with invocation, sixteen or up to twelve, / performed according to rule, are declared and traditionally known as offering.

3.s:
sampūjya sāvṛtiṃ devaṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ |
svasthānapreṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ mṛdvāsanamiti priye || 89 ||
3.d:
सम्पूज्य सावृतिं देवं षोडशैरुपचारकैः ।
स्वस्थानप्रेषणं प्रोक्तं मृद्वासनमिति प्रिये ॥ 89 ॥
3.m: Having worshipped the God with his retinue through the sixteen articles of worship, / sending him to his own abode is declared the soft seat, O Beloved.

3.s:
devaṃ     pūjārthamāhvānamāvāhanamiti    smṛtam |
āsane sanniveśaḥ syāt sthāpanaṃ kulanāyike || 90 ||
3.d:
देवं     पूजार्थमाह्वानमावाहनमिति    स्मृतम् ।
आसने सन्निवेशः स्यात् स्थापनं कुलनायिके ॥ 90 ॥
3.m: Summoning the God for the sake of worship is traditionally known as invocation; / placing [him] on the seat is the establishing, O Mistress of Kula.

3.s:
anyonyasammukhākāraḥ sannidhāpanamīritam |
yatra kutrāpyacalanaṃ    sannirodhanamīritam || 91 ||
3.d:
अन्योन्यसम्मुखाकारः सन्निधापनमीरितम् ।
यत्र कुत्राप्यचलनं    सन्निरोधनमीरितम् ॥ 91 ॥
3.m: Bringing face-to-face with one another is proclaimed bringing near; / remaining motionless anywhere is proclaimed confinement.

3.s:
devatāṅge ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syāt sakalīkṛtiḥ |
ācchādanaṃ         samuddiṣṭamavaguṇṭhanamīritam || 92 ||
3.d:
देवताङ्गे षडङ्गानां न्यासः स्यात् सकलीकृतिः ।
आच्छादनं         समुद्दिष्टमवगुण्ठनमीरितम् ॥ 92 ॥
3.m: The placement of the six limbs upon the body of the deity is ritual completion; / covering, as taught, is proclaimed veiling.

3.s:
darśanaṃ dhenumudrāyā amṛtīkaraṇaṃ  priye |
kṣamasvetyañjalirddevi paramīkaraṇaṃ priye |
svāgataṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ nigadeddevatāgrataḥ || 93 ||
3.d:
दर्शनं धेनुमुद्राया अमृतीकरणं  प्रिये ।
क्षमस्वेत्यञ्जलिर्द्देवि परमीकरणं प्रिये ।
स्वागतं कुशलप्रश्नं निगदेद्देवताग्रतः ॥ 93 ॥
3.m: The display of the cow-gesture is the nectarisation, O dear one; / the folded hands uttering 'Forgive me', O Goddess, is the supreme sanctification, O dear one; / greeting is an inquiry after well-being pronounced before the deity.

3.s:
pādyaṃ śyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntābhirucyate |
jātālavaṅgakakkolairuktamācamanīyakam   || 94 ||
3.d:
पाद्यं श्यामाकदूर्वाब्जविष्णुक्रान्ताभिरुच्यते ।
जातालवङ्गकक्कोलैरुक्तमाचमनीयकम्   ॥ 94 ॥
3.m: Water for the feet is declared to consist of śyāmāka grain, dūrvā grass, lotus, and viṣṇukrāntā; / water for rinsing the mouth is declared to consist of nutmeg, cloves, and kakkola berries.

3.s:
akhilāghapraśamanārddhanaputravivarddhanāt    |
anarghaphaladānācca arghyamityabhidhīyate || 95 ||
3.d:
अखिलाघप्रशमनार्द्धनपुत्रविवर्द्धनात्    ।
अनर्घफलदानाच्च अर्घ्यमित्यभिधीयते ॥ 95 ॥
3.m: Because it appeases all sins, increases wealth and sons, / and gives priceless fruit, it is called a water offering.

3.s:
siddhārthamakṣatañcaiva kuśāgraṃ tilameva ca |
yavaṃ gandhaḥ phalaṃ puṣpamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ prakīttītam || 96 ||
3.d:
सिद्धार्थमक्षतञ्चैव कुशाग्रं तिलमेव च ।
यवं गन्धः फलं पुष्पमष्टाङ्गार्घ्यं प्रकीत्तीतम् ॥ 96 ॥
3.m: White mustard, unhusked barley, tips of kuśa grass, sesame seeds, / barley, fragrant paste, fruit, and flowers are declared to be the eightfold water offering.

3.s:
madhvājyadadhibhiḥ prokto madhuparkaḥ kuleśvari |
dehaprakṣālanaṃ  snānaṃ    sugandhisalilaiḥ  saha || 97 ||
3.d:
मध्वाज्यदधिभिः प्रोक्तो मधुपर्कः कुलेश्वरि ।
देहप्रक्षालनं  स्नानं    सुगन्धिसलिलैः  सह ॥ 97 ॥
3.m: The honey-mixture offering is stated to be made of honey, clarified butter, and curd, O Mistress of Kula; / bathing is the washing of the body together with fragrant waters.

3.s:
candrācandanakastūrīkālāgurubhirucyate       |
aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātantu   kathitaṃ   vandanaṃ priye || 98 ||
3.d:
चन्द्राचन्दनकस्तूरीकालागुरुभिरुच्यते       ।
अष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातन्तु   कथितं   वन्दनं प्रिये ॥ 98 ॥
3.m: Camphor, sandalwood, musk, and dark aloe are declared [for perfumes]; / eight-limbed prostration is described as homage, O dear one.

3.s:
etaccarācaraṃ    sarvaṃ    kṣetramityabhidhīyate |
tat kṣetraṃ pālitaṃ yena kṣetrapālaḥ sa ucyate || 99 ||
3.d:
एतच्चराचरं    सर्वं    क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते ।
तत् क्षेत्रं पालितं येन क्षेत्रपालः स उच्यते ॥ 99 ॥
3.m: All this moving and unmoving world is called the sacred field; / he by whom that sacred field is protected is called the guardian of the sacred field.

3.s:
iti te kathitā kiñcid gurunāmādivāsanā |
samāsena maheśāni yo jānāti sa pūjakaḥ || 100 ||
3.d:
इति ते कथिता किञ्चिद् गुरुनामादिवासना ।
समासेन महेशानि यो जानाति स पूजकः ॥ 100 ॥
3.m: Thus has the inner meaning of the name of the guru and the rest been briefly told to you, / O Great Lady; he who knows it is a true worshipper.

3.s:
rahasyātirahasyānāṃ rahasyo'yaṃ    maheśvari |
ūrdhvāmnāyo'yamākhyātaḥ samāsena savistarāt || 101 ||
3.d:
रहस्यातिरहस्यानां रहस्योऽयं    महेश्वरि ।
ऊर्ध्वाम्नायोऽयमाख्यातः समासेन सविस्तरात् ॥ 101 ॥
3.m: This secret among the most secret of secrets, O Great Goddess, / this upper transmission has been declared in summary and in full detail.

3.s:
kulārṇavamidaṃ śāstraṃ yoginīnāṃ hṛdi sthitam |
prakāśitaṃ  mayā  cādya  gopanīyaṃ  prayatnataḥ || 102 ||
3.d:
कुलार्णवमिदं शास्त्रं योगिनीनां हृदि स्थितम् ।
प्रकाशितं  मया  चाद्य  गोपनीयं  प्रयत्नतः ॥ 102 ॥
3.m: This scripture, the Kulārṇava, abiding in the hearts of the yoginīs, / has been revealed by me today; it must be concealed with great effort.

3.s:
pustakañca maheśāni  paśugehe  na   nikṣipet |
na dadyāt paśuhaste  ca na paṭhet paśusannidhau |
na paṭhedāsavollāsaṃ granthaṃ bhūmau na nikṣipet || 103 ||
3.d:
पुस्तकञ्च महेशानि  पशुगेहे  न   निक्षिपेत् ।
न दद्यात् पशुहस्ते  च न पठेत् पशुसन्निधौ ।
न पठेदासवोल्लासं ग्रन्थं भूमौ न निक्षिपेत् ॥ 103 ॥
3.m: O Great Lady, one must not deposit the manuscript in the house of an uninitiated bound soul, / nor place it into the hands of an uninitiated bound soul, nor read it in the presence of an uninitiated bound soul; / one must not recite the chapter on fermented liquor [aloud], nor place the book upon the ground.

3.s:
nityaṃ  sampūjayedbhaktyā  jānīyād  guruvaktrataḥ |
nāputrāya   pravaktavyaṃ    nāśiṣyāya    kadācana || 104 ||
3.d:
नित्यं  सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या  जानीयाद्  गुरुवक्त्रतः ।
नापुत्राय   प्रवक्तव्यं    नाशिष्याय    कदाचन ॥ 104 ॥
3.m: One should worship it daily with devotion and learn it from the guru's mouth; / it must never be spoken to one who is not a son, nor to one who is not a disciple.

3.s:
snehāllobhādbhayāduktvā so'cirānnaśyati dhruvam |
devi yadvidyate prājñe  tattat  kiñcinmayoditam || 105 ||
3.d:
स्नेहाल्लोभाद्भयादुक्त्वा सोऽचिरान्नश्यति ध्रुवम् ।
देवि यद्विद्यते प्राज्ञे  तत्तत्  किञ्चिन्मयोदितम् ॥ 105 ॥
3.m: Speaking it out of affection, greed, or fear, he surely perishes before long; / O Goddess, whatever [wisdom] exists in the wise person, all that has been spoken by me in some measure,

3.s:
sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya bhuktimuktiphaleṣiṇām |
yaścordhvāmnāyamāhātmyaṃ paṭhet śrīcakrasannidhau || 106 ||
3.d:
साधकानां हितार्थाय भुक्तिमुक्तिफलेषिणाम् ।
यश्चोर्ध्वाम्नायमाहात्म्यं पठेत् श्रीचक्रसन्निधौ ॥ 106 ॥
3.m: for the benefit of practitioners who desire the fruits of enjoyment and liberation. / And whoever reads the greatness of the upper transmission in the presence of the Śrīcakra,

3.s:
bhaktyā paramayā devi yaḥ śṛṇoti sa kaulikaḥ |
vrataṃ   snānaṃ    tapastīrthaṃ   yajñadevārcanādiṣu || 107 ||
3.d:
भक्त्या परमया देवि यः शृणोति स कौलिकः ।
व्रतं   स्नानं    तपस्तीर्थं   यज्ञदेवार्चनादिषु ॥ 107 ॥
3.m: or whoever hears it with supreme devotion, O Goddess, that Kaulika / [receives the fruit of] vows, ablutions, ascetic penance, pilgrimages, sacrifices, worship of deities, and the like;

3.s:
tat  phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ  labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tvatsannidhau  sannivasennātra kāryā  vicāraṇā || 108 ||
3.d:
तत्  फलं कोटिगुणितं  लभते नात्र संशयः ।
त्वत्सन्निधौ  सन्निवसेन्नात्र कार्या  विचारणा ॥ 108 ॥
3.m: he obtains that fruit multiplied ten-millionfold, there is no doubt about this; / he dwells in your presence, no doubt should be entertained here.
